## Checklist

- [ ] `npm ci && npm run validate` passes locally
- [ ] Directly related documentation is updated
- [ ] Policy-floor impact: **none** / tightens / loosens (if it loosens, link the maintainer decision or ADR)
- [ ] No secrets, keys, tokens, or personal data added (placeholders used in docs and examples)
- [ ] GitHub Actions are pinned by full commit SHA and images by digest (if touched)
- [ ] Conventional Commit title
